title: Shadow Nova variation
author: Moose Flores, Stephen Ulrich
problems: Row 5 "form an ocean wave - larks by left hands and shadows by right hands and form short waves, balance the wave" can't start from where the dancers are: Nobody has a shadow to hold on an end.
Row 7 "shadows allemande right ¾, forming long waves" can't start from where the dancers are: This allemande does not end facing across, in long waves.
Row 8 "balance & Rory O'More left · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers are not in a straight line.
Row 8 "balance & Rory O'More left · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers are not in a straight line.
choices: Rory O'More spins one full turn in the travel direction.
The balance before each Rory steps toward the slide direction first.
Slice: half the counts on the diagonal, half straight back.
A star with no grip named is a basket star (wrist grip).
